subject: Re: Renewal QBR & roadmap demo — reschedule + recording/attendee ask
messages:
From: Julia Park <julia@horizonhealth.com>
To: david.kim@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@horizonhealth.com
Date: Sat, 6 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal QBR & roadmap demo — availability and recording

Hi David,

Apologies for the short notice — executive leadership just entered a brief travel/blackout week and asked we move our QBR demo. We still want to get the roadmap walkthrough and the contract SOW into your hands this week if possible, but need the live exec walkthrough to shift.

Current constraints: leadership is unavailable 12/8–12/12 daytime PST. They can do early mornings (7:30–9:00am) on 12/9–12/11 or afternoons (4:30–6:00pm) on 12/15–12/18. Procurement would also like the SOW and a final agenda before signature.

Can you:
- Propose 2-3 alternative windows for the live exec demo (we prefer a single 60–75 min slot)
- Confirm whether Redwood can record the session and share the recording internally (procurement needs a note on data handling)
- Share an updated agenda and a redlineable SOW

Thanks — looping Procurement on cc.

Best,
Julia Park
Sr. Director, Product & Strategy
Horizon Health

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia@horizonhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: naomi.feldman@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 6 Dec 2025 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR & roadmap demo — availability and recording

Julia — thanks for the heads up and totally fine to shift. Quick responses inline and a proposed plan below.

Recording: yes, we can record the executive walkthrough. Naomi (cc) will confirm retention and access (we host recordings for 90 days by default; we can provide a download and redact if needed).

SOW & agenda: attaching a draft SOW and the latest agenda for your review. Please flag any must-have items we should cover in the exec slot.

Proposed live exec windows (all PST):
- Option A: Tue 2025-12-09 — 7:30–8:45am (exec-friendly morning)
- Option B: Wed 2025-12-10 — 8:00–9:15am
- Option C: Tue 2025-12-16 — 4:30–5:45pm (post-blackout)

If none of these work, tell us the single best 75-minute block and we’ll prioritize.

Operational asks from our side to make the demo smooth:
- Final attendee list (names + roles) — please indicate who must be live vs. who can watch recording.
- Any redlines Procurement expects in the SOW prior to signature (we can accept a gated DocuSign flow).
- Any specific data retention / redaction needs for the recording (Naomi will follow up).

Next steps: If one of the options looks good, I’ll lock the calendar and Prioyom will coordinate the recording permissions and the run of show. If you want an exec-only pre-brief, we can do a 15-minute pre-brief 15 minutes before the slot.

Cheers,

—
David Kim
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: david.kim@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com, Julia Park <julia@horizonhealth.com>, IT Security <itsec@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Dec 2025 11:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR & roadmap demo — availability and recording

Thanks David / Julia. Quick security/data note:

- Recording retention: standard 90 days. If Horizon requires shorter retention or additional access controls we can honor that for the recording export (we’ll store in an access-controlled S3 bucket and can set a TTL).
- Redaction: we can provide an edited export if there are any PHI/IDs — please flag timestamps or segments to redact within 48 hours of the meeting.
- Evidence for procurement: I attached (inline) our standard recording handling blurb for Procurement to include in the SOW.

Procurement / IT Security — if you have a required PO cadence or invoice milestone you want us to mirror in the SOW, share that and we’ll align the doc.

Naomi
Director, Customer Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference

Attachment stub: security-handling-recordings.txt (short policy blurb)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia@horizonhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@horizonhealth.com>, david.kim@redwood.com, naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 8 Dec 2025 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR & roadmap demo — availability and recording

Julia / team — thanks, locking in Option B per Julia's quick reply (Wed 2025-12-10 08:00–09:15 PST). Confirmed: execs will attend live; broader product team will receive recording.

Action items we own:
- I’ve sent the SOW-draft-Horizon_Health.docx to Procurement for redline (attachment).
- Calendar invite + recording consent checkbox going out in the next 10 min. Please check the invite and accept so we can finalize AV and run of show.
- DocuSign link for signature will be sent once redlines are agreed — link: https://docusign.net/secure/sign?token=abc123-horizon

Julia — for the run of show I propose: 5 min intro (exec sponsor), 20 min roadmap/highlights, 20 min product deep-dive (use-case examples), 15 min Q&A, 5 min next steps. Let me know if you want to swap order.

Thanks everyone — Naomi will coordinate the recording retention note with Procurement.

—
Priyom Das
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: SOW-draft-Horizon_Health.docx, Redwood_QBR_Agenda_v3.pdf
